units.source_text: “既然不愁钱花，我就想要搬出嘈杂的寄宿住家，另找房子独住。

en.t: Since I was not short of money, I began to think of leaving my noisy boarding house and finding a place where I could live alone.

units.source_text: 但是，如此一来，既要添置日用器具，还要雇个管家的婆子，

en.t: But if I did that, I would have to buy household utensils and hire an old woman to look after the place,

units.source_text: 而且，这婆子还得老实本分，即使我不在家，也无须担心才行。

en.t: and that old woman would have to be honest and reliable, so that I would not have to worry even when I was away from home.

units.source_text: 所以，这事似乎也不大容易。

en.t: For that reason, the plan did not seem very easy to carry out.

units.source_text: 一天，我漫然想到，先找找房子看。

en.t: One day, on a whim, I thought I might at least try looking for a house.

units.source_text: 于是一边散步，一边沿着本乡台往西走下去，

en.t: So, taking a walk as I went, I headed west down along Hongo Plateau,

units.source_text: 顺着小石川的上坡路，一直往传通院方向走去。

en.t: then followed the slope at Koishikawa straight toward Dentsuin.

units.source_text: 通了电车之后，现在这一带已经完全改观了，

en.t: Since the streetcars began running through it, that whole area has changed completely,

units.source_text: 但那时候，左边是炮兵工厂的土墙，

en.t: but in those days, on the left stood the earthen wall of the artillery arsenal,

units.source_text: 右边是一片既非平原又非丘陵的空地，长满了荒草。

en.t: and on the right was an open stretch of land, neither plain nor hill, thick with wild grass.

units.source_text: 我站在草丛中，漫不经心地眺望着前面的山脊，

en.t: I stood among the grass and gazed idly at the ridge ahead.

units.source_text: 虽然现在依然很美，但当时还是西边的景致更入眼，

en.t: Even now the view is still beautiful, but in those days the scenery to the west was even more appealing,

units.source_text: 光是那生机盎然的满目葱绿，就足以让人心旷神怡了。

en.t: and the deep, living green that filled the eye was enough by itself to put the mind at ease.

units.source_text: 我忽然想到，这一带说不定会有合适的房子，

en.t: It suddenly occurred to me that there might be a suitable house somewhere around there,

units.source_text: 便马上穿过荒草覆盖的空地，沿着小路向北走去。

en.t: so I immediately crossed the wild grassy open ground and went north along a narrow lane.

units.source_text: 如今那里仍是个偏僻所在，那时候更是穷街陋巷，脏乱不堪。

en.t: Even today that place is still out of the way, and in those days its poor back streets were even more shabby and filthy.

units.source_text: 我穿过那片空地，拐进小巷，转来转去地溜达。

en.t: I crossed the open ground, turned into narrow alleys, and wandered around through one lane after another.

units.source_text: 最后，我向一家粗点心铺的老板娘打听，这一带是否有比较像样的出租屋。

en.t: At last I asked the woman who ran a cheap sweets shop whether there were any reasonably decent houses for rent nearby.

units.source_text: ‘这个嘛，’她歪着脑袋想了一下，说，‘出租屋好像没有……’

en.t: Well now, she said, tilting her head and thinking for a moment, there do not seem to be any houses for rent.

units.source_text: 我失望地正准备往回走时，她又问道：‘借宿人家行不行？’

en.t: Just as I was disappointed and about to turn back, she asked again, Would lodging in someone's house do?

units.source_text: 我一听，来了兴趣，心想，如果是自己一人寄居在清静的人家里，

en.t: When I heard that, my interest returned, and I thought that if I were lodging alone in a quiet private home,

units.source_text: 倒是省去了置办日用家具的麻烦，也蛮不错的。

en.t: it would spare me the trouble of buying household furniture and might actually be quite good.

units.source_text: 于是，便在这家点心铺里坐下来，向老板娘详细打听了那户人家的情况。

en.t: So I sat down in the sweets shop and asked the woman in detail about that household.
